review_notes.detail: All60 decoder inputs and10 OR inputs separately traced. Positive and negative register10 have disjoint segments on repeated columns; negative10 uses blank buses16/70 and positive09 uses blank bus54. Each decoder star hook descends to the K-marked physical output diamond; both output terminals share their printed FRAME net. FRAME nets branch to AL. No semantic complement or cross-page normalization was applied. K is an output-border marker, not an overflow socket suffix. Native extended OR79..88 retained.

Whole-column traces confirm AA turn49 and AG turn46, AH turn42, AC lower turn88 returning up toexternal64, AF lower turn87 returning up toexternal74. These native turns avoid gate bodies. Connector table fully read including native AK F09 versus E04 continuation discrepancy.
